items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: King Oliver would have turned in the grave spiraling if he would have heard this !

ctx.x: And what did you say about the Tuxedo Band? Oh, yes.

So, yes. He came then on the recording of the Young Tuxedo Band to talk and he said, King Oliver would have turned in the grave spiraling if he would have heard this ! Yeah, that is of course very sad, if we wanted to do that, and that we wanted to do that and that we would get such a brief and then get such a brief.
